name: Summit AZ - Blogs Folder Overview
body:
> Log · Summit Az · 2026-10-12

# Summary
Working folder for every Summit AZ blog post: markdown drafts, WP-ready HTML, banners, inline images, Utah originals and the scripts that converted, enhanced and published posts. The blog was built from zero starting 2026-06-18 (no blog and no single-post layout existed before, per the 2026-09-24 progress report). By the 2026-10-12 page tracker sync, 33 blog posts were live.

# Topic notes (one per blog)
- June batch (live 2026-06-18/22): [Summit AZ - Blog - Signs of Hard Water](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-signs-of-hard-water), [Summit AZ - Blog - Signs of a Hidden Water Leak](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-signs-of-a-hidden-water-leak), [Summit AZ - Blog - Outdoor Faucet Leaking](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-outdoor-faucet-leaking), [Summit AZ - Blog - Signs You Need a New Water Heater](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-signs-you-need-a-new-water-heater), [Summit AZ - Blog - How to Prevent Clogged Drains](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-how-to-prevent-clogged-drains), [Summit AZ - Blog - Are Water Softeners Worth It](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-are-water-softeners-worth-it), [Summit AZ - Blog - Tankless vs Tank Water Heater](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-tankless-vs-tank-water-heater), [Summit AZ - Blog - Signs of a Slab Leak](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-signs-of-a-slab-leak), [Summit AZ - Blog - Trenchless Pipe Lining](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-trenchless-pipe-lining)
- July batch drafts (unpublished): [Summit AZ - Blog - July 2026 Batch Brief](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-july-2026-batch-brief) and its six topic notes
- Water pressure cluster (live 2026-08-12): [Summit AZ - Blog - Low Water Pressure in Mesa (Pillar)](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-low-water-pressure-in-mesa-pillar) and three supporting notes
- Later: [Summit AZ - Blog - Old Cracked Pipes Scottsdale](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-old-cracked-pipes-scottsdale), [Summit AZ - Blog - Sewer Line Repair or Replacement](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-sewer-line-repair-or-replacement), [Summit AZ - Blog - Tankless Water Heater Descaling](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-tankless-water-heater-descaling)
- Clusters: [Summit AZ - Blog Cluster - July Monsoon 2026](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-cluster-july-monsoon-2026), [Summit AZ - Blog Cluster - August Drain Cleaning 2026](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-cluster-august-drain-cleaning-2026)

# Live posts with no local draft in this folder
Per the page tracker: grease in drain (2026-10-12), what not to put in a garbage disposal (2026-09-09), water softener maintenance checklist (2026-09-25), salt-free vs salt-based softener Arizona (2026-09-17), snowbird plumbing checklist (2026-10-01), hard water plumbing damage Mesa and trenchless sewer repair Mesa (2026-08-18), water heater repair Mesa (2026-08-12). Banners for several of these (grease, disposal, softener maintenance, post-monsoon checklist Mesa) are in `banners\`.

# Utah flag
- `_utah_originals\` holds five Utah-site posts (hard water, hidden leak, outdoor faucet, new water heater, prevent clogged drains) that were localized to Arizona. They mention Utah cities and must not be published on summitplumbingpros.com.
- Three image filenames still contain "utah" (hose bib, hidden leak home, hard water faucet); alt text was changed to Arizona.

# Files in this folder
- `*.md` drafts with META and Verification blocks; `*.html` WP bodies.
- `banners\`: final banners plus option renders (gr, sm, tk, v, gd series) and `_make_banner*.py` scripts; `banners\assets\` has the Summit logo (svg, jpg).
- `images\`: inline images.
- `_wp2\`, `_wp_new\`, `_wp_b3\`, `_fix\`: WP-ready body versions per publish batch (`_fix\post_5779/5783/5787.html` are corrected bodies).
- `_template\build_single.php`: built the Elementor Pro Single Post template (fixed featured images never displaying).
- `_snippet_install*.php` and `related-carousel.js.html`: Code Snippets installers for a related-posts carousel (arrows and auto) and an automatic FAQ accordion on posts (2026-06-25).
- `_convert.py`, `_enhance*.py`, `_wp_gen*.py`, `_add_related.py`: conversion and publishing scripts (not summarized).
